notes: Every heading goes through this component. Media (Icon/LottieIcon/Image) passed as nested component node — child atoms own their props. Subtitle renders via Text atom. Pipeline strips visual/animation props in textonly.

_rules.action: Heading auto-injects semanticRole='background' on the Shape — runtime guarantee, JSON value (if any) is overridden. Shape is wallpaper for the child atom; child owns aria/label.

contentHeadingSubtitle.description: Optional subtitle line below the heading. Render via Text atom. Omit if not needed — empty strings rejected.

brandColor._description: 'text' = body text scale, always readable, never overridden by brand neutral changes.

colorTier._note: Implicit baseline is 'base' (set by .color--{name} mixin). Omit to use.

gradientEmerge._description: Fade-in modifier — bg-context holds then fades to colour.

gradientFade._description: Fade-out modifier — bg-context holds then fades to colour (softer hold than emerge).

gradientFlip._description: Reverse gradient direction on the text — mirrors the wrap gradient for contrast.

size._note: Text sizes (xs-xl) for gradient body text via Heading

textShadow._note: Implicit baseline is 'none' (no .text-shadow--* class emitted). Omit to use.

media._description: Nested atom node. When mediaBg=false (default) media is a single atom (Icon | LottieIcon | Image | Shape). When mediaBg=true media must be a Shape containing a child atom (Icon | LottieIcon | Image) via its own media prop — set the Shape's semanticRole='background' to declare intent (Shape is wallpaper, child owns meaning).

mediaBg._description: true = media is a Shape wrapping a child atom (used as background container).

mediaBgSize._description: Padding inside the Shape wrapper around the child icon. Only used when mediaBg=true; value is forwarded to the nested Shape atom.
mediaBgSize._note: Implicit baseline is 'normal' (applied by Shape's own default). Omit to use.

mediaSize._note: Implicit baseline is 'auto' (no size prop forwarded to child atom; child uses CSS em-based sizing inherited from .heading-wrap--{level}). Omit to use.

highlightShadow._description: Contrast shadow on solid highlights. 'auto' = applies only to solid (default), 'on' = force on, 'off' = force off.
highlightShadow._note: Implicit baseline is 'auto' (no .text-highlight--shadow or --no-shadow class emitted; CSS handles auto-shadow on solid variants). Omit to use.

highlightCycle._description: Animate highlight colour through tier tokens (tint → mid → base → back). Gated by motion settings.

underlineTier._note: Implicit baseline is 'base' (set by .color--{name} mixin). Omit to use.

underlineStyle._note: Implicit baseline is 'solid' (no .underline--* style class emitted). Omit to use.

underlineGap._note: Implicit baseline is 'default' (no .underline--gap-* class emitted). Omit to use.

dividerTier._note: Implicit baseline is 'base' (set by .color--{name} mixin). Omit to use.

dividerStyle._note: Implicit baseline is 'solid' (no .divider--* class emitted). Omit to use.

gradientAnimateDirection._description: Animation direction — clockwise, counter-clockwise, or sway.
gradientAnimateDirection._note: Implicit baseline is 'cw' (no [data-grad-anim-dir] attribute emitted). Omit to use.

gradientAnimateSpeed._description: Animation speed — slow (20s), default (12s), fast (6s). Gated by motion settings.
gradientAnimateSpeed._note: Implicit baseline is 'default' (no .gradient--speed-* class emitted). Omit to use.

gradientCycle._description: Colour cycle — cross-fades through the element's own tier tokens (tint→mid→base→emphasis).
